name: Vasudev Siddh
headline: AI & Full-Stack Engineer
summary: AI engineer who builds production voice agents and LLM systems, from prototype to tested release. Creator of JustHireMe (2,249★ open source).

bullets: Use Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and WebRTC to build real-time voice AI, so users can hold natural, low-delay conversations with an AI assistant.
Add automated evaluations and regression tests so LLM changes are checked before they reach users; build data-access controls that limit who sees which data.
Rebuilt an AI assistant backend and took it to production; golden-eval pass rate improved from 32/54 to 52/54.
Reduced time to first results from 72–122 s to under 10 s.
Reduced search latency from 10.6 s to 53 ms.
Built a multi-million-vector retrieval index answering in ~15–21 ms.
